claim: SquadStack sells a managed engagement, not a self-serve product, on its marketing site: every CTA is 'Book a Demo'/'Get Proposal', the vs-Bolna page says 'You're hiring a partner to deliver sales conversion outcomes, not a platform for your team to build on', and campaigns are created by SquadStack ('Reach out to voicesales@squadstack.com to create your campaign').

Marketing describes four pillars (AI Lead Manager, Humanoid AI Agent, AI+Human Supervisor, ROI Optimizer) surfaced as seven modules: Lead Intelligence, Humanoid AI Agent, Omnichannel (call, WhatsApp, SMS, in-app), Quality Monitoring (23 parameters), ROI Optimizer, Voice of Customer Insights, Control Tower.

The customer portal (portal.app.squadstack.com, Next.js) exposes 61 routes in its public build manifest: agents (human telecaller hiring/persona), analytics, api-integration, billing, call-details/[botCallId], campaigns (create/edit/leads/lead journey/FAQs/script/workflow/ImportHistory/PaymentContract), lead-prioritization (auto, custom grouping, rules, select logic), logs, realtime-logs, observability, reports, intel-assist, downloads, settings (account, integrations, subscriptions, teams), plug-n-play (campaign create/edit, payment-success), auth/signup and a customer-specific route /parul-live.

A separate AI agent builder exists at ai-platform.squadstack.ai ('Welcome to squadstack.ai: Build, deploy, and optimize personalized AI voice agents in minutes'; email or Google sign-in). Its bundle defines routes for Agents, Call Details, Agent Evals, QA Config (old/new engine), Leads, Analytics, Reports, Import History, Knowledge Base, Observability (infra/application/outcome/call-quality), Voice Library, Text-to-Speech, Sales/In-App demo pages, Try Entity Extraction, Onboarding and Account. It is not linked from the marketing site.

verification.note: Routes and auth copy re-observed. Addition: both this build and app.osno.ai gate sign-in to an allowlist (SQS-70).

claim: The workflow builder in the portal composes Voice Bot, Lead Router, Call (human), multi-level IVR, SMS (Sender ID + DLT Entity ID) and Email blocks; router blocks may connect only to Voice Bot or Call blocks; rescheduled calls can be served by the bot or by human agents.

A 'Plug-N-Play' SME path exists in the portal: industry templates, Shopify/Shiprocket lead sync, auto-generated script and FAQs pending approval, caller-type selection by CEFR level (human telecallers), a pricing package with 'Price per min' and free SMS credits, GSTIN verification, proforma invoice, wallet balance, subscription and top-up plans.

Lead prioritisation is a rule engine with a data-science script that mines past conversions for metadata rules (min converted leads per rule, 7-day simulation) plus TAT-based auto-prioritisation (live leads, rescheduled, un-attempted first).

Human telecalling is still a live product line: the portal hires 'players' (get-player-hiring-request, player persona), and the partner app 'SquadStack Telesales Partner' (com.squad.run) has 10L+ installs, 15,007 ratings, 3.85 stars, updated 18 Apr 2026.
The In-App Voice AI Assistant ships as a hosted JS SDK (d1iba7cd9se7zf.cloudfront.net/main.js, last modified 2026-10-06) supporting voice and omnichannel bot types with chat box and call timer.

In code, the AI platform's prompt builder offers a transfer_call() trigger for positive call closings, and custom scenarios such as "Live Seller Transfer". Whether a customer can point it at an arbitrary number was not seen. The old source page /fully-managed-telecalling-for-sales-operations-teams 301-redirects to / (re-checked 2026-10-20).

The only public API (Postman documenter at apidocs.squadstack.com, published 2024-05-31) is lead ingestion: per-campaign endpoints api.squadstack.com/voice/crm-integration-v2/<ref_id>/lead-{created,updated,upserted,converted,disabled,deleted}, single and bulk (100 leads/request), basic auth, 100 requests/min default, IP whitelisting mandatory. Outbound data is disposition webhooks built per customer: call events (phone_number, lead_id, recording_url, campaign_id, called_at, call_outcome like 'Connected : Objective Met', call_attempt_number) and a 'judgement' event when the lead journey ends (lead_outcome, latest_recording_url); S3 drop as an alternative; HubSpot via workflows or Airbyte hosted by SquadStack; LeadSquared via LAPP.

verification.note: Re-read chunk 8449 and the agent-editor page chunk (downloaded by the verifier). h=["eleven_multilingual_v2"] is a HIDE list (fT: a model is hidden unless the agent already uses it), not a default. With legacy Multilingual v2 it is INR 3.3-5.3; Cartesia Sonic-3.6, INR 1.9-3.5; Sarvam Bulbul, INR 1.2-2.7; self-hosted TTS, INR 0.7-2.1. But the headline frame is wrong: eleven_multilingual_v2 is on the editor's hide-list (legacy), not "the bundle default"; the TTS default constant is eleven_flash_v2_5, billed at the Flash/Turbo rate ($40 per 1M chars). claim: Volume consistency check: Arth's "1 crore+ minutes in two months" at 80% of calls implies on average about 2 lakh AI minutes a day (about 7.6 crore a year; INR 15-38 Cr a year at INR 2-5), the same order as FY24 revenue of INR 26.5 Cr. Because the two months include a ramp, today's rate can be higher. Even at 5x, "50 lakh+ calls a day" is at most about 0.2 min per call, so "calls" means dial attempts, not conversations.

verification.note: Arithmetic holds (1 crore / ~60 days / 0.8 = ~2.1 lakh min/day; x365 = ~7.6 crore; INR 15-38 Cr at INR 2-5). Caveat added: the 1 crore covers a two-month ramp, so the current daily rate can be above the average. The "dial attempts" conclusion survives a 5x error (0.2 min per call). FY24 revenue predates the AI-minute mix, so the revenue comparison is order-of-magnitude only.
verification.claim_before: Volume consistency check: Arth's '1 crore+ minutes in two months' at 80% of traffic implies about 2 lakh AI minutes a day (about 7.5 crore a year, INR 15-37 Cr a year at INR 2-5), the same order as FY24 revenue of INR 26.5 Cr; '50 lakh+ calls a day' is then about 0.04 min per call, so 'calls' must mean dial attempts, not conversations.
